approach.description.from: The Capstone approach considers sustainability in relation to industry, market, buyer, and business goal. It is designed to support procurement readiness, rather than define one universal sustainability score.
approach.description.to: MOSAIC considers sustainability in relation to industry, market, buyer, and business goal. It is designed to support procurement readiness, rather than define one universal sustainability score.

approach.thirdBody.from: The intended assessment pairs transparent results with source-grounded guidance on what to improve.
approach.thirdBody.to: The assessment pairs traceable results with guidance on what to improve, each point citing its source.

research.methodBody.from: The Capstone baseline preserves questions, answer scales, benchmarks, contextual weighting, and source documents. The planned assessment keeps deterministic calculations separate from AI-generated recommendations. Weights represent expected relevance, not calibrated statistical probabilities.
research.methodBody.to: MOSAIC keeps its questions, answer scales, benchmarks, contextual weighting, and source documents as explicit, versioned configuration. Scores follow fixed rules and are kept separate from the AI-written recommendations. Weights represent expected relevance, not calibrated statistical probabilities.
research.methodBody.note: Says 'fixed rules' instead of 'deterministic'. Leave the verification and limitations text to the owner; it reflects build status.
